name: Armory Castle vSphere campaign (Nov 2026)
description: Techniques observed in the ARMORY CASTLE (formerly UNC5221) intrusion chain BeyondTrust Remote Support -> Linux appliance -> vCenter (CVE-2026-123890) -> ESXi, as reported by Mandiant/GTIG on 19 Nov 2026. Mapping by Stelios Partsinevelos (Mandiant's post lists no ATT&CK IDs). Dark red = observed AND covered by a Sigma rule in this repository; light = observed, hunting only.

techniques.comment: Custom malware sets: SLIMSAVAGE, CAGEMATCH, BEARBONES, BONESAW, SAWSNAKE, LAZYBONES. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
BONESAW: Go exploit utility for the vCenter zero-day CVE-2026-123890 (build timestamp Jul 13, 2026). | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
Obfuscation infrastructure includes compromised third-party firewalls/routers exposing the BEARBONES banner. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
Initial access: zero-day CVE-2026-102764 in BeyondTrust Remote Support (fixed in BT26-05). | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
Commands run via /bin/sh -c through the SLIMSAVAGE web shell and SSH sessions. | Detection in this repo: linux_armory_castle_tool_paths.yml, linux_gdb_command_file_or_suid_set.yml
JSP web shells SLIMSAVAGE (ActiveSer.jsp) and CAGEMATCH (u.jsp) on the Linux appliance. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
LAZYBONES (/usr/bin/vmtoolscs) runs as a systemd service that restarts it every 50 minutes. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
Attacker SSH public key added to ESXi root authorized_keys. | Detection in this repo: esxi_shell_ssh_key_or_vmfs_staging.yml
Local vCenter admin sps-<REDACTED>@vsphere.local created; BONESAW also creates an SSO admin and a machine account. | Detection in this repo: vcenter_sso_admin_account_sps_pattern.yml
BEARBONES: backdoored Dropbear with hardcoded password bypass and plaintext credential logging. | Detection in this repo: linux_ssh_server_started_from_tmp.yml
gdb command file decoded to "!chmod u+s /bin/env" to set SUID and gain root. | Detection in this repo: linux_gdb_command_file_or_suid_set.yml
Authenticated to ESXi as vpxuser, then SSH as root. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
Base64-encoded commands decoded into /tmp/gdb_file. | Detection in this repo: linux_base64_decode_to_tmp.yml, linux_curl_to_tmp_or_rar_extract.yml
SAWSNAKE, its outputs and the hidden staging directory deleted with rm. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
LAZYBONES named vmtoolscs to look like VMware Tools. | Detection in this repo: linux_armory_castle_tool_paths.yml
BEARBONES spoofs the banner SSH-2.0-pulsesecure_23345. | Detection in this repo: zeek_ssh_pulsesecure_banner.yml
Data staged in a hidden ".a" directory on a VMFS datastore. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
vmfs_browser.py read files directly from a guest Windows VMDK on VMFS. | Detection in this repo: esxi_shell_ssh_key_or_vmfs_staging.yml
CVE-2026-123890 (vmdir SRP-6a session key disclosure) exploited by BONESAW over TCP 2012 to gain SSO admin. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
STS SAML RSA signing key stolen by BONESAW; SSH private key /tmp/123.key used for ESXi access. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
vmdir data.mdb exfiltrated; vCenter master key and PostgreSQL password file taken over SSH. | Detection in this repo: vcenter_vmdir_database_access.yml
Golden SAML: BONESAW and SAWSNAKE forge SAML 2.0 assertions, bypassing MFA. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
NTDS.dit, SYSTEM and SECURITY extracted from a guest domain controller disk. | Detection in this repo: esxi_shell_ssh_key_or_vmfs_staging.yml
nmap -sS against VMware ports 9080, 5480, 2012, 443, 389. | Detection in this repo: linux_nmap_vmware_management_ports.yml
WinSCP used to enumerate the ESXi file system, disks and VMFS volumes. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
vmdir service on vCenter exploited remotely (TCP 2012) from the compromised Linux appliance. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
SSH enabled on vCenter via VAMI, then SSH to vCenter and to ESXi as root. | Detection in this repo: vcenter_vami_ssh_enabled_via_api.yml
Stolen files staged in /vmfs/volumes/<volume>/.a before transfer. | Detection in this repo: esxi_shell_ssh_key_or_vmfs_staging.yml
Data archived as o.tar.gz; tools delivered as password-protected RAR. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
LAZYBONES uses Slack (conversations.history, external file upload APIs) for C2. | Detection in this repo: proxy_slack_api_from_server.yml
curl downloads of the RAR utility and BONESAW into /tmp. | Detection in this repo: linux_curl_to_tmp_or_rar_extract.yml
BEARBONES SSH listeners on TCP 53 and TCP 33992. | Detection in this repo: linux_ssh_server_started_from_tmp.yml
LAZYBONES C2 encrypted with AES-256-CTR. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
Archives moved from ESXi to the appliance with scp, then pulled out via HTTP GET. | No rule in this repo yet (see hunting checklist).
